svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-flight-jacket-green","name":"CAP green flight jacket (MA-1 / CWU-36/P / CWU-45/P) with blank nametag","size_in":{"w":55.8,"h":32.975},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,5580,3297.5],"size_source":"regulation","size_citation":"MIL-J-8279G, Military Specification: Jacket, Cold Weather (type MA-1), 18 Mar 1988, Table V p. 19 (finished measurements, size Medium) and Table IV pp. 7-9 (pocket flap, pocket, cigarette/pencil pocket); read from the page images.","size_basis":"Medium: back length 22 1/2, 1/2 chest 26, 1/2 bottom 23 1/2, sleeve inseam 16 3/8 in; flap 7 1/2 x 2 3/8 in; cigarette pocket 5 3/4 x 3 1/4 in. Not given by the spec and therefore ESTIMATED: collar and knit heights, armhole depth, shoulder width, sleeve girth, flap lean, patch positions on the chest. Shape follows CAPR 39-1 Figure 8.3.","dimension_sources":{"back_length_in":"regulation MIL-J-8279G Table V","half_chest_in":"regulation MIL-J-8279G Table V","half_bottom_in":"regulation MIL-J-8279G Table V","sleeve_inseam_in":"regulation MIL-J-8279G Table V","flap_in":"regulation MIL-J-8279G Table IV op. 3","sleeve_pocket_in":"regulation MIL-J-8279G Table IV op. 6","nametag_in":"regulation CAPR 39-1 8.2.4.1","flag_in":"regulation CAPR 39-1 8.2.4.4","loop_square_in":"regulation CAPR 39-1 8.2.5.5","knit_heights_collar_armhole_shoulder_sleeve_girth":"estimated","command_patch_width":"estimated"},"flag":{"side":"wearer's left sleeve (image right)","drawn":"in the garment image (flat sleeve view and, clipped to the arm, the front view)","size_in":[3.5,2],"border":"gold","position":"1/2 in below the shoulder seam","orientation":"normal: canton (union) toward the wearer's front / the viewer's left on the outer face of the left sleeve;
